$comment: Design values every awsome-* surface uses. scripts/ui-check.py (C3, C9) checks the layout and the shared menu/confirm constants against this file. Change a value here first, with its source.

menu.source: shadcn/ui new-york-v4 ContextMenu spacing (content p-1 rounded-md border shadow-md; item px-2 gap-2 rounded-sm; svg size-4; separator -mx-1 my-1), made compact on a 4px scale to match the sidebar (2026-11-25, user): item row 28 like SidebarMenuButton sm, group title 24 styled like SidebarGroupLabel (11, medium, muted); text 13

confirm.source: Herdr mods/confirm (popover, radius 8, 15px semibold title, 32px buttons) with the rules in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §2.6

contrast.source: WCAG 2.2 AA; hover/selected floor agreed with the user on 2026-11-25

label.source: Herdr sidebar's six space colors; tint strength from docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §2.4

sidebar.source: shadcn/ui new-york-v4 Sidebar: SidebarGroup p-2; SidebarGroupLabel h-8 px-2 text-xs font-medium text-sidebar-foreground/70; SidebarGroupAction w-5 [&>svg]:size-4; SidebarMenu gap-1; SidebarMenuButton size sm h-7 p-2 gap-2 rounded-md; SidebarMenuBadge h-5 min-w-5 px-1 text-xs font-medium tabular-nums. Text mapped like the menu: text-sm -> 13, text-xs -> 11. Sub-agent indent follows docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §2.2 (12px a level with a guide line, as in the Files tree) instead of SidebarMenuSub's mx-3.5 + px-2.5. Groups (2026-11-26, the user chose tinted blocks): one block per group in its color at label.tint, as wide as a row, radius 8 like a row; 8 between a block and its neighbours (SidebarGroup p-2); the header's chevron sits in a 16px slot on the icon column and its name on the name column.

settings.source: shadcn/ui new-york-v4 Item (variant outline, size sm: px-4 py-3 gap-2.5) and Field (FieldContent gap-1.5, FieldTitle font-medium, FieldDescription muted); grouped rows in one bordered card like macOS System Settings / Windows 11 Settings; sidebar rows as in the awsome sidebar. Text 13 / 12 like the rest of the app. Alignment (2026-11-26, user: as many invisible lines aligned as possible): page title, group headings and row titles share one x (card edge + rowPadX = headingIndent); controls and every reset icon share one right edge; the nav's first label and the page title share one centre line (navInset + navLabel/2 = pagePadY + headerRow/2).

picker.source: The menu family (menu tokens, shadcn ContextMenu): same pad, radius, separator and selected/hover overlays; cells are a menu row's height, square, touching like menu rows (2026-11-26, user: compact, no regional whitespace). The current color also gets a 2px foreground ring 2px off the dot (Chrome tab groups), inside the cell.

preview.source: VS Code editor.wordWrapColumn default 80 (src/vs/editor/common/config/editorOptions.ts); width of 80 code columns plus the viewer's 6-column line-number gutter at the default 14px font and the viewer's 0.62 character width = about 770px; the layout can only say weights, so 4:3 against `main` gives 762px of a 1334px work area with the files panel closed, and still leaves `main` 410px with it open (2026-11-26, user asked for a wider default)
